hook.en: In class we do not shout, copy others' notes or share someone's secret. The same manners apply in a WhatsApp group or on Instagram.

body.en: A responsible netizen follows net etiquettes. Be ethical: do not use copyrighted material without permission, and share expertise. Be respectful: respect privacy and diversity of opinions. Be responsible: avoid cyber bullying, do not feed the troll.
body.kn: ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ನೆಟಿಜನ್ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನೈತಿಕವಾಗಿರಿ: ಅನುಮತಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹಕ್ಕುಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯದ ವಸ್ತು ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ. ಗೌರವದಿಂದಿರಿ: ಖಾಸಗಿತನ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸಿ. ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತರಾಗಿರಿ: ಸೈಬರ್ ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ಬೇಡ, ಟ್ರೋಲ್‌ಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

title.en: On the board: Three kinds of etiquette for netizens

say.en: A responsible netizen follows three sets of good manners online.
Net etiquettes: be ethical, be respectful and be responsible. Do not feed the troll.
Communication etiquettes: be precise, be polite and be credible.
Social media etiquettes: be secure with passwords and be reliable: verify before you forward.
Example: forwarding a rumour without checking breaks the rule be reliable.

narration.en: We draw a tree of net etiquettes, communication etiquettes and social media etiquettes.

prompt.en: Which net etiquette does each habit follow: be ethical, be respectful or be responsible?
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಯಾವ ನೆಟ್ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ: ನೈತಿಕ, ಗೌರವಯುತ, ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ?

text.en: Ask the owner before using their photo in your project
Do not download pirated movies or software
Answer forum questions on a topic you know well
Do not post a friend's phone number without asking
Accept that others may hold a different opinion
Do not tag people in photos without their consent
Do not forward mean messages about a classmate
Ignore a troll instead of replying angrily

explanation.en: Being ethical means no copyright violation and sharing expertise; being respectful means respecting privacy and diverse views; being responsible means avoiding cyber bullying and not feeding the troll.
explanation.kn: ನೈತಿಕತೆ: ಕೃತಿಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯ ಉಲ್ಲಂಘಿಸದಿರುವುದು. ಗೌರವ: ಖಾಸಗಿತನ ಮತ್ತು ಭಿನ್ನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಗೌರವಿಸುವುದು. ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ: ಸೈಬರ್ ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಸುವುದು.

body.en: Communication etiquettes: be precise (respect time and data limits), be polite, and be credible (think before you comment). Social media etiquettes: be secure (strong passwords, beware of fake information, think before uploading) and be reliable (verify before you share).
body.kn: ಸಂವಹನ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ: ನಿಖರವಾಗಿರಿ, ವಿನಯದಿಂದಿರಿ, ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹರಾಗಿರಿ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ ಶಿಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ: ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿರಿ (ಬಲವಾದ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್, ನಕಲಿ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರ) ಮತ್ತು ಹಂಚುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

problem.en: A forwarded message in your class group says "Colleges closed tomorrow due to heavy rain — share fast!". What should a responsible netizen do?

steps.en: Do not forward it immediately; it may be fake.
Check the college website or official notice, or ask the class teacher.
If it is false, tell the group politely and do not spread it further.

answer.en: Verify from an official source before sharing; never spread unverified news.
